name: System Event 3
definition: Provides details on an event occurring in a system, whether planned or unplanned as stipulated in the specifications of the system.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Nature of the event that has occurred.

ScheduledTime.name: Scheduled Time
ScheduledTime.definition: Date and time at which the event is foreseen to occur.

EffectiveTime.name: Effective Time
EffectiveTime.definition: Date and time at which the event effectively takes place.

StartTime.name: Start Time
StartTime.definition: Time at which the event starts.

EndTime.name: End Time
EndTime.definition: Time at which the event ends.
